placements.why: The organization establishes formalized onboarding procedures and rituals for incoming team members, defining a foundational organizational stratum.
placements.title: Operationalizing structured new hire onboarding and team enablement
placements.frame: How does the organization structure and execute onboarding for new members?

placements.title: Mandating structured first-week onboarding checklists replaces ad-hoc documentation with guided operational integration
placements.frame: How are new hires integrated into systems, pairing rotations, and operational shifts during their initial week?
placements.why: Segments src-1 and src-2 establish the mandatory first-week Pallasine checklist (encompassing accounts, pairing rotation, and shadow shifts) that superseded the legacy wiki documentation.
